weekly_price_change_probability.application: Representative scenario only. A fixed Bernoulli mechanism is an academic assumption, not measured independence.

conditional_absolute_price_change.application: Typical nonzero-change size. Sign is separate. Stress levels use reference quantiles, without extrapolating causal sales response.

conditional_up_share.application: Representative direction mix, not weighted by frequency or a fitted joint distribution.

store_volume_factor.application: Sensitivity scenarios. No mapping of foreign stores to own stores and no claim of local factors.

retail_monthly_zero_probability.application: External contrast and stress only. Preserve Monash automotive baseline. Not stockout probability.

monthly_variability.application: Sensitivity range, not a new noise distribution or replacement of existing academic assumptions.

calendar_amplitude.application: External sensitivity reference. Bolivian peak months, phase and event effects remain assumptions, not copied from M5.

positive_burst_p95_over_median.application: Conditional tail stress reference. Not wholesale probability, order size or local base demand.

positive_burst_p99_over_median.application: Extreme observed-tail sensitivity only. Fractional and unknown cohorts cannot set integer units.

promotion_daily_probability.application: Favorita conditional frequency and coverage are diagnostics. A simulated promotion schedule requires an explicit independent academic assumption before feature cutoff.

bolivian_exchange_rate_stock_modalities_.application: Retain versioned academic assumptions or obtain authorized own evidence. Lead times remain separate replenishment scope.

integration: No generator or frozen contract changed. A future version must explicitly consume this configuration before creating any new build.
unsupported: Commercial use or redistribution automatically authorized
quantiles: Exact per series, then exact equal-series summaries. No systematic sample.
windows: REFERENCE sets policy. COMPARISON descriptive only, previously observed globally. Not untouched TEST.
